The '''Republic Troop Transport''', also known as the '''RTT''' or the '''Republic Convoy Transport'''<ref name="SWTCW:PG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>, was a ground transport that saw widespread use by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Rtt_heavy_combat.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An RTT under attack by [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra magna tri-droids]]]]
This [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] vehicle had low speed and very little armor, but was armed with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and two [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass driver missile launchers]] for self-defense. It could be carried onboard an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]] to quickly reach strategic points on the battlefield.

==History==
RTTs were used to transport the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to the [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Petranaki arena|arena]] so they could rescue [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Following this, they saw action in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], particularly early on in that conflict. They were notably deployed at the [[Evacuation of Rhen Var]], during the [[Dark Reaper crisis]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a similar [[RM-09 Alliance shuttle|design]] meant for space travel was utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
